classification_definition: Candidate-area correspondence to the visible car (RGB) or car-related event outline (EVS) is supported near the candidate. This is not a proof that all alarm-driving inputs came from the car.
limits: Fixed candidate-start tiles are not tracking boxes.
Center 10 ms preview is different from past 2 ms detector input.
Four snapshots do not establish the first visible frame; onset annotations were retained, not reannotated.
No visual inspection of zero-candidate negative recordings was possible in this candidate-only bundle.
Physical synchronization and exact causal input events were not independently checked.
